import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Calculate total spending and age
df['TotalSpending'] = (df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + 
                       df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds'])
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Income vs Total Spending by Education
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
education_order = ['Basic', 'Graduation', 'Master', 'PhD']
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1', '#FFA07A']
for i, edu in enumerate(education_order):
    if edu in df['Education'].values:
        subset = df[df['Education'] == edu]
        ax1.scatter(subset['Income'], subset['TotalSpending'], 
                   alpha=0.6, s=50, label=edu, color=colors[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Income ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Income vs Total Spending by Education Level', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax1.legend(title='Education', frameon=True, fancybox=True)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Age distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
ax2.hist(df['Age'], bins=30, color='#6C5CE7', alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age (years)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Customer Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='y')

# 3. Spending by category
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :2])
spending_categories = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                      'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
category_names = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
avg_spending = [df[cat].mean() for cat in spending_categories]
bars = ax3.barh(category_names, avg_spending, color=['#A8322D', '#FF6B35', '#8B4513', 
                                                      '#4E89AE', '#FFB4B4', '#FFD700'], 
                edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Average Spending ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Average Spending by Product Category', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='x')
for i, v in enumerate(avg_spending):
    ax3.text(v + 10, i, f'${v:.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Purchase channels comparison
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
channels = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store']
channel_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
channel_totals = [df[col].sum() for col in channel_cols]
colors_pie = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(channel_totals, labels=channels, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                     colors=colors_pie, startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 10})
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax4.set_title('Purchase Distribution\nby Channel', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)

# 5. Income distribution by marital status
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :2])
marital_status_order = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts().index[:5]
data_for_box = [df[df['Marital_Status'] == status]['Income'].dropna() 
                for status in marital_status_order]
bp = ax5.boxplot(data_for_box, labels=marital_status_order, patch_artist=True,
                 medianprops=dict(color='red', linewidth=2),
                 boxprops=dict(facecolor='lightblue', alpha=0.7))
for patch in bp['boxes']:
    patch.set_facecolor('#A8DADC')
ax5.set_xlabel('Marital Status', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Income ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Income Distribution by Marital Status', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='y')
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15)

# 6. Campaign acceptance rate
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
campaigns = ['Cmp1', 'Cmp2', 'Cmp3', 'Cmp4', 'Cmp5', 'Response']
campaign_cols = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 
                 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
acceptance_rates = [(df[col].sum() / len(df)) * 100 for col in campaign_cols]
bars = ax6.bar(campaigns, acceptance_rates, color='#2A9D8F', alpha=0.8, edgecolor='black')
ax6.set_ylabel('Acceptance Rate (%)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Campaign Acceptance Rates', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='y')
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for i, v in enumerate(acceptance_rates):
    ax6.text(i, v + 0.5, f'{v:.1f}%', ha='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
